title: Brentwood AccuPac CF1900 - Cross Fluted Film Fill
description: The Brentwood AccuPac CF1900 is cross fluted film fill designed counterflow cooling towers and can be used in crossflow towers. View other types of fill we offer!

layout.title: Brentwood AccuPac CF1900 - Cross Fluted Film Fill

paragraphs: High Efficiency Fill, also known as cross corrugated fill, is the highest performance film fill available with excellent water re-distribution properties. AccuPac® Cross-Fluted Fills improve water distribution by splitting the water stream as it descends through the fill pack. High thermal performance (high KaV/L) and low pressure drop are balanced by utilizing the engineered microstructure design and maintaining the highest manufacturing standards.
